paper_source_conflicts: Opt4 is defined at every turbine and time index, while only an aggregated 12 by 5 wind rose is published.
Table III says average of 10 trials, while the case-study text explicitly says the Scenarios I-IV program is run 20 times.
completion_decisions: Retain all five target roles: direction-only and Scenarios I-IV.
Digitize Figure 6 deterministically into 12 directions and 5 speed bins, then normalize the 60 masses.
Represent the 10-row by 8-column regular farm by seven within-row gaps, nine between-row gaps and an optional center rotation.
Map every time-indexed Opt4 control to each turbine in each of the 60 published wind states, producing 4800 pitch variables and 4817 joint variables.
Decode Opt4 as nonnegative pitch beyond a rotor-feasible MPPT baseline and use a smooth NREL-rated-power/12.1-rpm CP surface completion with induction-consistent CT.
Retain partial-overlap Jensen wakes, RSS multiple wakes, hierarchical collection and export cable losses, LPC, the 1000000 penalty factor and 504--2520 m gap bounds.
Calibrate otherwise unavailable wind, loss, cable and OAM scales to the theta=0 Table-II anchors without calibrating optimized solutions.
Use the complete Zhan APSO evolutionary factor, four memberships, sigmoid inertia, state-dependent c1/c2 control and Gaussian elitist learning.
Use a 20-percent velocity bound, sparse pitch initialization around the zero additional-dispatch incumbent and 100 direction-only maximum iterations.
Use the text-authoritative 20 repeats for each Scenario I-IV and 10 repeats for direction-only.

roles: Direction only: one theta variable, population 15, 10 repeats
Scenario I: 16 row/column gaps, population 30, 50 iterations, 20 repeats
Scenario II: 16 gaps plus theta, population 35, 70 iterations, 20 repeats
Scenario III: 80 turbines by 60 wind-state pitch controls, population 100, 120 iterations, 20 repeats
Scenario IV: 16 gaps, theta and 4800 pitch controls, population 120, 230 iterations, 20 repeats

physics.wind: deterministic normalized digitization of the published 12-direction by 5-speed Figure-6 wind rose
physics.wake: published Jensen radius growth kd=0.04, exact rotor/wake circle overlap and root-sum-square multiple deficits
physics.power: NREL 5 MW dimensions and operating bounds, reconstructed smooth CP(beta,lambda), induction-consistent CT and 5 MW cap
physics.control: rotor-feasible MPPT baseline plus nonnegative per-turbine/per-wind-state additional pitch
physics.loss: published hierarchical three-phase I-squared-R collection topology plus the reported 55 km export cable
physics.cost: published cable/LPC structure with Table-II anchored unavailable coefficients and OAM

algorithm.evolutionary_factor: exact mean Euclidean particle distances and normalized global-best distance
algorithm.state: four published fuzzy membership functions with stable cyclic transition preference
algorithm.acceleration: uniform delta in [0.05,0.1], state-dependent c1/c2 changes, each clamped to [1.5,2.5] and normalized to sum at most 4
algorithm.elitist_learning: one random global-best dimension, Gaussian sigma linearly from 1.0 to 0.1, accept as best or replace the current worst
algorithm.stopping: paper maximum-iteration receipt or 50 unchanged best-objective iterations

physical_fes_ledger.unit: one complete 80-turbine, 60-wind-state wake, power, hierarchical cable-loss, cost, pitch-constraint and LPC evaluation
physical_fes_ledger.population: every initial or updated particle consumes one physical FES
physical_fes_ledger.elitist_learning: every convergence-state candidate consumes one physical FES
physical_fes_ledger.distance_and_parameter_control: algorithm bookkeeping does not consume physical wind-farm FES

hpc_execution.particle_parallelism: one persistent worker team evaluates and updates particles
hpc_execution.apso_state_parallelism: the exact upper triangle of the particle-distance matrix is computed once per pair in parallel, mirrored, then reduced by row
hpc_execution.ordered_semantics: counter-keyed random events and ordered best/personal-best reductions preserve worker-count identity
hpc_execution.h6_rule: same full 4800-variable Scenario-III source, seed, population, iterations, physical FES, decision, evaluation and hash with one versus all Waffle workers
hpc_execution.formal_rule: two concurrent 10-worker paper runs occupy all 20 Waffle cores

claim_boundary: academic flexible reconstruction of APSO and all five paper-native problem roles; not author code, native FINO3/cable/control arrays, original random stream, or exact numerical optimum replay
